senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; עָרַם I)pile, heap, stack.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:5">Maasr. I, 5</cite>, sq. <he>משיעמיד ע׳</he> (are subject to tithes) from the time he piles up the fruit.

<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 3:17">Tosef. Ter. III, 17</cite> <he>תורמין מן הע׳ על הכרי לא מן הכרי על הע׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>מן המוץ</he>) you may separate T’rumah from a stack for the pile (of threshed grain), but not from a pile for the stack.
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 4:16">Ib. IV, 16</cite> <he>ע׳ מורחת</he> a finished pile.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 31:9">Ex. R. s. 31</cite> <he>כשם שה׳ הזאת עומדת … כך עשה הק״בה את העולם ע׳ וכ׳</he> as the stack stands ready, and the priest goes in and takes T’rumah of it, so the Lord has made the world a stack and taken Israel as his T’rumah (with ref. to <cite ref="Jeremiah 2:3">Jer. II, 3</cite>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>עֲרֵימוֹת</he>, <he>עֲרֵמוֹת</he>. Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 6 (expl. <he>נערמו</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 15:8">Ex. XV, 8</cite>) <he>עשאן כמין ע׳</he> he made the waves stand like stacks; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 248:2">Yalk. Ex. 248</cite>.
